description: OMOP CDM v5.4 DEATH table — clinical event for how and when a Person dies. May be set by a clinician or derived from an administrative source.

fields.label: Person ID
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the deceased person. The demographic details of that Person are stored in the PERSON table.

fields.label: Death Date
fields.description: The date the person was deceased.

fields.label: Death Datetime
fields.description: The date and time the person was deceased.

fields.label: Death Type Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key referring to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting how the death was represented in the source data.

fields.label: Cause Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key referring to a standard concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies for conditions.

fields.label: Cause Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the cause of death as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Cause Source Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the concept that refers to the code used in the source.
